top.title: Dubai's Golden Visa scheme rewards outstanding educators on World Teachers' Day

top.headline: Dubai Grants Golden Visas to Outstanding Teachers
top.summary: Hundreds of private school and university educators in Dubai received long-term residency. This initiative honors exceptional teaching contributions across the emirate.
